title: coder: version decision functions and admit workload-specific policies
body:
<!-- openagents-project-triage:start -->
## Project triage

Project: [Coder as Decision Router Consumer](https://github.com/orgs/OpenAgentsInc/projects/16) · Workstream: Decision integration · Priority: P1 · Readiness: Blocked.

Parent tracker: #9501.

Open prerequisites linked with native **blocked by** relationships: #9486, #9485. Completed admission prerequisite: #9473; its native link is retained.

Function inventory and stable IDs can start immediately. Full admitted model/policy behavior consumes review, admission, and backend-capability contracts; individual functions ship only with evidence for their supported scope.

<!-- openagents-project-triage:end -->

---

Make each judgment Coder consumes a named, versioned function with an explicit role and measured policy.

Specification: [decision functions and policies](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/coder/coder-as-decision-router-consumer.md#decision-functions-and-policies). Consumer tracker: #9501. Service tracker: #9481.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Inventory current decision sites and unify code-defined turn/shell questions with file-defined program questions through stable IDs, schema versions, question digests, and input/output contracts.
- [ ] Bind each function to allowed model/artifact profiles, state limits, evaluation/calibration evidence, policy version, and typed abstain/review behavior. Executor selection can consider only host-authorized candidates; operator-pinned selections remain pinned.
- [ ] Give any new context/relevance, review, ranking, or executor-choice question a baseline/headroom test before production. Preserve retired questions and historical digests without reintroducing questions merely to increase API use.
- [x] Correct the meaning of requires_calibration: require admitted workload/model-specific evidence for that promise, or rename the existing probability/name check so it cannot imply calibration.
- [ ] Integrate opt-in #9485 review/fallback with original and reviewed results, nullable reviewer scores, complete attempt/cost attribution, and local data-disclosure restrictions.
- [ ] Select thresholds on development data and confirm on held-out data; tests must cover confident wrong answers, missing evidence, changed artifacts, and absent candidates.

## Dependencies and boundaries

#9485, #9473, #9486 and existing Gym evidence; no universal confidence threshold or noise floor.

Product code remains Rust; reuse the repository's shared contracts and manual/non-GitHub verification. This issue describes planned work, not implemented behavior.
